title: 比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機~Strepy-Thieu boat lift
focus: 纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接~Cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces
summary: 本課以比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機為入口，深入纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Strepy-Thieu boat lift as its entry point, this course examines cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
history: 斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機以兩座獨立船廂跨越中央運河的大高差，官方資料提供纜索式升船機與齒條式系統的比較脈絡。官方旅遊機構歷史摘要記錄工程於一九八二年開始。 瓦隆與SOFICO官方資料確認升船機於二〇〇二年投入服務。 機電手冊更新提供纜索設備分析背景，並非升船機改建事件。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~Strepy-Thieu uses two independent caissons to bridge a large level difference on the Canal du Centre, providing public context for comparing cable-driven and rack-driven lifts. The official tourism history summary records construction beginning in nineteen eighty-two. Walloon and SOFICO sources confirm the lift entering service in two thousand two. Updated mechanical guidance supplies cable-equipment analysis context, not a reconstruction event at the lift. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 船廂水位與額外質量~Caisson level and extra mass
units.title: 船廂水位與額外質量~Caisson level and extra mass
units.mechanism: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。大平面船廂即使小幅水位變化，也會使配重平衡出現明顯差異。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。~Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. A level error directly changes water volume, so even a small change across a large plan area noticeably alters counterweight balance. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion.
units.verify: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。另外檢查船舶進出時水位計受到遮蔽的區段。~Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates. Also identify intervals when vessel entry or exit obstructs the level measurement.
units.failure: 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。~Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension.
units.misconception: 浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。~A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
units.practice: 以船廂水位與額外質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for caisson level and extra mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates.

units.anchor: 纜索群載重分配~Cable-group load sharing
units.title: 纜索群載重分配~Cable-group load sharing
units.mechanism: 多條懸吊索讓總荷載分散，但單索張力取決於長度、剛度與均衡裝置。總索數除重量只提供理想平均，不保證最大索力或端部連接需求。 假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。~Many suspension ropes distribute total load, but individual tension depends on length, stiffness and equalization. Dividing weight by rope count gives an ideal mean rather than the maximum tension or anchorage demand. Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN. A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN.
units.verify: 建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。以最大值和分位數呈現分配，而非只有平均值。~Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions. Report maxima and distribution quantiles instead of presenting only the mean tension.
units.failure: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。~A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups.
units.misconception: 總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。~Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
units.practice: 以纜索群載重分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cable-group load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions.

units.anchor: 均衡梁槓桿關係~Equalizer lever equilibrium
units.title: 均衡梁槓桿關係~Equalizer lever equilibrium
units.mechanism: 均衡梁藉槓桿轉動重新分配索力，但臂長、接頭摩擦與行程限制會影響效果。能轉動的機構不一定仍處於有效均衡範圍。 假設總力2 MN、兩臂長0.8與1.2 m，力矩平衡T1×0.8=T2×1.2，T1=1.2 MN、T2=0.8 MN；理想無摩擦鉸接。 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。只確認梁體沒有裂紋，無法證明整個調平機構仍能有效動作。~An equalizer redistributes tension through lever rotation, with arm length, joint friction and travel limits controlling performance. A movable mechanism is not necessarily still within its effective equalization range. Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m. From T1×0.8=T2×1.2, T1=1.2 MN and T2=0.8 MN, for an ideal frictionless pivot. Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. An uncracked beam alone does not establish that the complete leveling mechanism still functions effectively.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總力2 MN、兩臂長0.8與1.2 m，力矩平衡T1×0.8=T2×1.2，T1=1.2 MN、T2=0.8 MN；理想無摩擦鉸接。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m. From T1×0.8=T2×1.2, T1=1.2 MN and T2=0.8 MN, for an ideal frictionless pivot.
units.verify: 同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。對照梁端止擋距離與可容許的剩餘調平行程。~Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium. Compare hysteresis during opposite load changes and verify that ends have not reached geometric travel stops. Compare end-stop distances with the remaining available travel for tension equalization.
units.failure: 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。只確認梁體沒有裂紋，無法證明整個調平機構仍能有效動作。~Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. An uncracked beam alone does not establish that the complete leveling mechanism still functions effectively.
units.misconception: 均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。~The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
units.practice: 以均衡梁槓桿關係編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for equalizer lever equilibrium, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium. Compare hysteresis during opposite load changes and verify that ends have not reached geometric travel stops.

units.anchor: 索輪曲率與彎曲循環~Sheave curvature and bending cycles
units.title: 索輪曲率與彎曲循環~Sheave curvature and bending cycles
units.mechanism: 鋼索反覆繞過輪槽時，單絲承受彎曲與接觸作用，輪徑對索徑比是重要幾何指標。該比值不能單獨給出疲勞壽命，還需張力譜和索結構。 假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。 索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。若只用循環次數或直徑比決定狀況，會漏掉局部磨擦與腐蝕。~Ropes repeatedly bending over grooves experience wire bending and contact. Sheave-to-rope diameter ratio is useful geometry, but fatigue life also depends on tension spectrum and rope construction. Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50. At 20000 bends annually, five years gives 100000 bends, a count rather than a life guarantee. Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden. Cycle count or diameter ratio alone misses localized rubbing and corrosion mechanisms.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50. At 20000 bends annually, five years gives 100000 bends, a count rather than a life guarantee.
units.verify: 對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。確認檢測覆蓋同一段鋼索而非不同索段。~Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones. Interpret lubrication, magnetic inspection and visual evidence together rather than using any one indicator alone. Verify that repeated inspections cover the same rope section rather than different segments.
units.failure: 索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。若只用循環次數或直徑比決定狀況，會漏掉局部磨擦與腐蝕。~Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden. Cycle count or diameter ratio alone misses localized rubbing and corrosion mechanisms.
units.misconception: 索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。~A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue.
units.practice: 以索輪曲率與彎曲循環編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sheave curvature and bending cycles, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones. Interpret lubrication, magnetic inspection and visual evidence together rather than using any one indicator alone.

units.anchor: 捲揚轉速與機械效率~Winch speed and mechanical efficiency
units.title: 捲揚轉速與機械效率~Winch speed and mechanical efficiency
units.mechanism: 捲揚機把索的線速度轉為轉速，減速機改變轉矩和速度但不創造功率。有效鼓徑隨繞層可能改變，因此編碼器轉角不一定固定對應索長。 假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。 多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。~Winches convert rope speed to rotation. Gear reduction exchanges speed and torque without creating power, while changing winding radius can alter the relationship between encoder angle and rope travel. Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip. Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. Rope slip can leave rotational signals agreeing while actual travel differs, requiring independent displacement evidence.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip.
units.verify: 比較編碼器轉角與獨立索長量測，按繞層和鼓槽位置分組；再核對輸入轉速、輸出轉矩與功率，確認效率不超過物理上限。對獨立行程資料進行完整往返閉合檢查。~Compare encoder angle with independent rope travel, grouped by winding layer and groove position. Check input speed, output torque and power together to ensure inferred efficiency respects physical limits. Check independent travel measurements for closure over a complete outward and return movement.
units.failure: 多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。~Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. Rope slip can leave rotational signals agreeing while actual travel differs, requiring independent displacement evidence.
units.misconception: 減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。~Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
units.practice: 以捲揚轉速與機械效率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較編碼器轉角與獨立索長量測，按繞層和鼓槽位置分組；再核對輸入轉速、輸出轉矩與功率，確認效率不超過物理上限。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for winch speed and mechanical efficiency, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare encoder angle with independent rope travel, grouped by winding layer and groove position. Check input speed, output torque and power together to ensure inferred efficiency respects physical limits.

units.anchor: 塔架側移與導向~Tower sway and guidance
units.title: 塔架側移與導向~Tower sway and guidance
units.mechanism: 高塔的側向柔度改變導向間隙和索具幾何，風與熱作用可能疊加。簡化懸臂模型適合比較剛度敏感性，不能替代含橫梁與基礎的整體模型。 假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。 基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。單點位移也可能受測站移動影響，若缺少獨立基準就會誤判導向系統的幾何變化。~Tower lateral flexibility changes guide clearance and rope geometry, with wind and thermal effects interacting. A cantilever model compares stiffness sensitivity without replacing the full frame and foundation model. Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation. Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending. A moving survey station can also imitate sway and misidentify changes in guidance geometry without independent references.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation.
units.verify: 用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。將測得塔身曲率與基礎轉角分別列出比較。~Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Check the cantilever shape before deciding whether frame or soil coupling is required. Report measured tower curvature separately from foundation rotation for direct comparison.
units.failure: 基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。單點位移也可能受測站移動影響，若缺少獨立基準就會誤判導向系統的幾何變化。~Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending. A moving survey station can also imitate sway and misidentify changes in guidance geometry without independent references.
units.misconception: 塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。~Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations.
units.practice: 以塔架側移與導向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tower sway and guidance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Check the cantilever shape before deciding whether frame or soil coupling is required.

units.anchor: 配重行程與幾何邊界~Counterweight travel and geometric limits
units.title: 配重行程與幾何邊界~Counterweight travel and geometric limits
units.mechanism: 船廂與配重之間的索路幾何決定行程比，不能僅由名稱推定一比一。滑輪組、端部空間與纜索彈伸共同限制可達位置。 假設理想索路長度約束x+2y=constant，船廂上升60 m則配重位移y=−30 m；此為教學滑輪配置，非宣稱本站索路。 把虛構滑輪比例套到實際系統會直接錯估行程，索具伸長也會改變端部餘裕。即使中段運動正常，端部空間不足仍可能成為主要限制。~Rope routing determines the travel ratio between caisson and counterweight; it cannot be inferred from terminology alone. Pulley arrangements, endpoint space and rope extension jointly constrain reachable positions. Assume an ideal teaching rope constraint x+2y=constant. A caisson rise of 60 m gives counterweight displacement y=−30 m; this is not a claim about the actual site routing. Applying an assumed pulley ratio to the real system misstates travel, while rope extension changes endpoint clearance. Normal mid-travel motion does not establish adequate space near the ends.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理想索路長度約束x+2y=constant，船廂上升60 m則配重位移y=−30 m；此為教學滑輪配置，非宣稱本站索路。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an ideal teaching rope constraint x+2y=constant. A caisson rise of 60 m gives counterweight displacement y=−30 m; this is not a claim about the actual site routing.
units.verify: 沿圖面追蹤每段索長變化，逐一核對固定和活動滑輪；用低速量測的兩端位移比驗算幾何，並把伸長補償和端部餘裕分開。於索路各端標出正方向以防行程符號錯誤。~Trace length change along every rope segment, identifying fixed and moving pulleys. Verify geometry using measured endpoint travel ratios and separate extension compensation from end-clearance allowance. Mark positive directions at every rope endpoint to prevent travel-sign errors.
units.failure: 把虛構滑輪比例套到實際系統會直接錯估行程，索具伸長也會改變端部餘裕。即使中段運動正常，端部空間不足仍可能成為主要限制。~Applying an assumed pulley ratio to the real system misstates travel, while rope extension changes endpoint clearance. Normal mid-travel motion does not establish adequate space near the ends.
units.misconception: 任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。~Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
units.practice: 以配重行程與幾何邊界編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿圖面追蹤每段索長變化，逐一核對固定和活動滑輪；用低速量測的兩端位移比驗算幾何，並把伸長補償和端部餘裕分開。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for counterweight travel and geometric limits, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Trace length change along every rope segment, identifying fixed and moving pulleys. Verify geometry using measured endpoint travel ratios and separate extension compensation from end-clearance allowance.

units.anchor: 制動動能與停止距離~Braking energy and stopping distance
units.title: 制動動能與停止距離~Braking energy and stopping distance
units.mechanism: 制動需吸收整個移動系統的動能，配重不會抵銷動能。停止距離與減速度相關，而不平衡重力可能在同一方向持續加入能量。 假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。 反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。只以低速空載停止測試推論高能量工況，會低估距離與熱負擔。~Brakes absorb kinetic energy of the moving system, which counterweights do not cancel. Stopping distance depends on deceleration, while imbalance gravity may continue adding energy in the direction of motion. Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ. Constant deceleration 0.01 m/s² gives stopping distance 1.125 m. Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. Extrapolating a slow unloaded stop to high-energy conditions understates distance and thermal demand on the braking system.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ. Constant deceleration 0.01 m/s² gives stopping distance 1.125 m.
units.verify: 將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。把指令延遲造成的自由行程另加到總停止距離。~Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Record brake heat and gravity direction separately to distinguish kinetic absorption from sustained loading. Add travel during command-response delay separately to the total stopping distance.
units.failure: 反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。只以低速空載停止測試推論高能量工況，會低估距離與熱負擔。~Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. Extrapolating a slow unloaded stop to high-energy conditions understates distance and thermal demand on the braking system.
units.misconception: 配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。~Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy.
units.practice: 以制動動能與停止距離編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for braking energy and stopping distance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Record brake heat and gravity direction separately to distinguish kinetic absorption from sustained loading.

units.anchor: 對接間隙充水體積~Docking-gap filling volume
units.title: 對接間隙充水體積~Docking-gap filling volume
units.mechanism: 船廂與固定航道之間的間隙需要形成可控水域，間隙體積影響水位變化和密封負荷。幾何體積不是漏水量，兩者應以不同量測辨認。 假設有效對接截面50 m²、間隙長0.25 m，充水體積12.5 m³；若由面積1000 m²船廂供應，理想水位下降12.5 mm。 若把正常間隙填水當成密封漏流，會誤判設備狀況；反之持續漏水被短時大流量掩蓋時也可能漏報。水位解析度不足更會使兩種原因難以區分。~The docking gap between caisson and fixed reach forms a controlled water volume. Its geometry influences level change and seal loading, but gap volume is not leakage and requires a separate measurement interpretation. Assume docking cross-section 50 m² and gap length 0.25 m, giving fill volume 12.5 m³. Supplied by a 1000 m² caisson, ideal level reduction is 12.5 mm. Normal gap filling can be mistaken for seal leakage, while large initial flow can conceal sustained leakage. Inadequate level resolution further obscures the distinction between temporary storage and a continuing defect.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效對接截面50 m²、間隙長0.25 m，充水體積12.5 m³；若由面積1000 m²船廂供應，理想水位下降12.5 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume docking cross-section 50 m² and gap length 0.25 m, giving fill volume 12.5 m³. Supplied by a 1000 m² caisson, ideal level reduction is 12.5 mm.
units.verify: 以間隙幾何、充水累積量與船廂水位三者互核，確認填滿後流量是否回到預期基線；將短時儲水和持續漏流分成不同判讀窗口。以充水完成後穩定流量估算持續密封漏流。~Cross-check gap geometry, cumulative filling and caisson level, verifying flow returns to its expected baseline after filling. Use separate interpretation windows for temporary storage and sustained leakage. Estimate continuing seal leakage from stable flow after the gap finishes filling.
units.failure: 若把正常間隙填水當成密封漏流，會誤判設備狀況；反之持續漏水被短時大流量掩蓋時也可能漏報。水位解析度不足更會使兩種原因難以區分。~Normal gap filling can be mistaken for seal leakage, while large initial flow can conceal sustained leakage. Inadequate level resolution further obscures the distinction between temporary storage and a continuing defect.
units.misconception: 對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。~All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.
units.practice: 以對接間隙充水體積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以間隙幾何、充水累積量與船廂水位三者互核，確認填滿後流量是否回到預期基線；將短時儲水和持續漏流分成不同判讀窗口。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for docking-gap filling volume, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Cross-check gap geometry, cumulative filling and caisson level, verifying flow returns to its expected baseline after filling. Use separate interpretation windows for temporary storage and sustained leakage.

units.anchor: 雙船廂服務與可用度~Two-caisson service and availability
units.title: 雙船廂服務與可用度~Two-caisson service and availability
units.mechanism: 兩座獨立船廂可以增加服務彈性，但共用航道與維修資源會形成瓶頸。至少一座可用和兩座同時達到全部容量，是不同的可靠度問題。 假設兩船廂獨立可用度各0.95，至少一座可用為1−0.05²=0.9975；兩座同時可用0.95²=0.9025，未含共同原因。 把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。必須先定義成功條件再引用數值。~Two independent caissons improve service flexibility, but shared approaches and maintenance resources can constrain capacity. Availability of at least one differs from simultaneous availability of full two-caisson throughput. Assume independent caisson availability 0.95 each. At least one is available with probability 0.9975, while both are available with probability 0.9025, excluding common causes. Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. A closed shared approach can prevent both healthy caissons from serving traffic, so success must be defined before quoting probabilities.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩船廂獨立可用度各0.95，至少一座可用為1−0.05²=0.9975；兩座同時可用0.95²=0.9025，未含共同原因。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent caisson availability 0.95 each. At least one is available with probability 0.9975, while both are available with probability 0.9025, excluding common causes.
units.verify: 分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。另外報告共用航道不可用時造成的服務中斷。~Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Identify outages occurring in the same event before accepting an independence assumption. Report service interruptions caused by an unavailable shared navigation approach separately.
units.failure: 把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。必須先定義成功條件再引用數值。~Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. A closed shared approach can prevent both healthy caissons from serving traffic, so success must be defined before quoting probabilities.
units.misconception: 至少一座船廂可用就代表整個系統完整容量可用。~At least one available caisson means full system capacity is available.
units.practice: 以雙船廂服務與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for two-caisson service and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Identify outages occurring in the same event before accepting an independence assumption.
